# 74200 - 256 bit RAM

Package DIP-16 · family 74S · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74200.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74200.json)

|---|---|---|

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

| 3 | /ME1 | enable | low |  | controls pins 6; when not enabled: float; memory enable; all three must be low |

| 5 | /ME3 | enable | low |  | controls pins 6; when not enabled: float |
| 12 | /WE | input |  |  | write enable, active low; while low the output is in high impedance |
| 13 | DATA | input |  |  | data input |
| 6 | Y | output |  | three-state | enabled by 3,4,5,12; output: the stored bit, which is the complement of the data written |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | Y = MEM[address] when ME1'=ME2'=ME3'=L AND WE'=H; otherwise Z | Read: the stored bit (complement of the data that was written) appears at Y. Any ME' high, or WE' low (write), puts Y in high impedance. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 256

Changes on: WE' low while ME1', ME2', ME3' are all low (level-sensitive write)

- Write: ME' all low and WE' low: MEM[address] = NOT DATA (the complement is stored); output Z
- Read: ME' all low and WE' high: Y = MEM[address]
- Inhibit: any ME' high: Y = Z, no write
- Address: row decoder A,B,C,H (pins 1,2,15,14) and column decoder D,E,F,G (pins 7,9,10,11), 16 x 16 matrix

## Not known

- Datasheet is for the Schottky DM74S200; whether ND's '74200' is this part or an earlier non-Schottky part with the same pinout is not settled by any datasheet read.
- No minimum delays printed.

## Notes

ND's catalogue id is 74200; the only datasheet found for a 256x1 RAM numbered 200 is the S (Schottky) version.

## Sources

- [National Semiconductor 1977 Memory Databook, DM54S200/DM74S200 256-bit read/write Schottky memories with TRI-STATE outputs](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/national/_dataBooks/1977_National_Memory_Databook.pdf) - 2-11 to 2-13 (PDF pages 114-116); DM74S200 (Schottky); no datasheet for a plain 74200 was found
